children: Senzime AB signed a contract with a major eastern US multi-hospital system to deploy 60 TetraGraph units, expected to monitor ~10,000 patients annually via disposable TetraSens sensors, expanding its US installed base.
Adds a large multi-hospital network, boosting footprint and sales visibility.
Grows installed base, a key driver for recurring sensor revenue.
Implies recurring demand for TetraSens disposables tied to usage.
Supports scale and cross-sell across the IDN over time.

This extends Senzime’s ongoing US expansion with additional large systems, reinforcing a recurring-revenue model. A larger catalyst would be confirmed volume ramps, broader IDN rollouts, or disclosed revenue/ASP metrics quantifying impact.
